WITH execution_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(exec_count) as total_count,
    CAST(1.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as avg_share
  FROM execution_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ec.ordertune,
    ec.exec_count,
    CAST(ec.exec_count AS REAL) / s.total_count as share,
    s.avg_share
  FROM execution_counts ec
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    exec_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(exec_count) as count_sum,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_average;
